baseline_provenance.why: regression.py compares live results against this to report fixed and, more importantly, broken. Without it, fixed/broken could only be measured against semantic_evaluator_v2, which would credit Phase 8.7 for what Phase 8.5 and 8.6 already did and could not see a repair breaking a case v3 already had right.

note: before/after are reported twice on purpose: against semantic_evaluator_v2, which is what the earlier phases meant by before, and against the pre-Phase-8.7 pipeline, which is the only comparison that can show a repair breaking a case v3 already had right.
